offer.text: Everyone keeps saying I should take up her trade. I do not even know what a smith does all day. Come round the workshops with me and I will decide for myself.

accept.text: The smith first. Then the mason, if I have not lost my nerve.

decline.text: Fine. I will ask somebody who has time.

in_progress.text: Two more. You said you would come.

ready.text: The smith, then. It is the smith.

complete.text: I told them I was apprenticing. They did not laugh. Thank you for coming with me.
